notes: Login uses parameterised query — tested with classic tautology payloads; all return 401.
Search variable goes through Jinja autoescape — script tags rendered as text.
Download enforces secure_filename and resolved-path containment under FILES_DIR.
Ping uses shell=False with strict host allowlist; metacharacter payloads return 400.
Profile requires authenticated session and only returns the current user's record.
Import endpoint accepts only JSON dict with a key allowlist; binary blobs return 400.
Register uses bcrypt; legacy hashing removed.
Secrets loaded from environment; no credentials remain in source.
Seed users hashed with bcrypt at init time; no plaintext columns remain.
